items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: So I had the experience of working with these guys with Doc's band.

ctx.x: And there was another trumpet player, ...[INAUDIBLE NAME]... It was the first time I saw a guy playing without the buttons on. He had taken the buttons off the keys, you know. And they called him the Viper. And he was some trumpet player, a very spectacular trumpet player.

So I had the experience of working with these guys with Doc's band. That's what really got me on the road. We'd go out on tours during the summer, and it was a spectacular feat(?) at 12 years old going out on a tour, you know.
